description: Upload a local image, video or audio file (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF up to 50MB; MP4, WebM, MOV up to 200MB; MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, FLAC up to 50MB) and get back a public URL that expires after 24 hours. Free. Pass an audio URL as song_url to pixeldojo_film for a music video. Pass the URL as image_url (stills) or video_url (clips) to tools that take hosted URLs only, such as pixeldojo_character, pixeldojo_storyboard and pixeldojo_upscale. pixeldojo_generate, pixeldojo_edit and pixeldojo_ad take local paths directly and need no separate upload.

path.description: Absolute local file path. Allowed: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF (≤50MB), MP4, WebM, MOV (≤200MB) or MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, FLAC audio (≤50MB). Returns a public URL on the temp CDN; auto-expires after 24h.

name: pixeldojo_upload
title: Upload local file
